finding.contract: K2 cancellation/terminal commit atomicity; K1 subsequent-run isolation impact
finding.expected: Accepted cancellation during running state yields cancelled, preserves unknown-write precedence, and does not quarantine next clean UI run. Alternatively cancellation after an atomically established terminal commit must be refused.
finding.actual: Formal API accepts cancellation, run:cancel-requested seq34 precedes stale blocked run:completed seq35; proof validation finds inspection-cancelled, quarantines run and next UI task.
finding.reproMethod: Actual compiled service, formal HTTP API, Chromium. A test-only libsql execute wrapper yields immediately before terminal blocked UPDATE and calls cancellation API, then forwards original SQL unchanged. No product mutations or synthetic production evidence.

focusedTests.command: pnpm exec vitest run src/inspection/blocker-evidence.test.ts evaluation/private/url-scan/boundary-scorer.test.ts src/execution/network/closeout.test.ts src/execution/executor.test.ts -t 'blocker|durable boundary|allowed or failed execution|cancels admitted reads|genuinely dispatched unknown business write|cannot dispatch a write through'
